name: Novijen
description: The Simic headquarters where the experiments take place.

description_citations.text: "Life is Beautiful". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Momir Vig says Experiment Kraj was designed to choose its own evolution.
timeline.quote: it was designed to choose its own evolution.

citation.text: Experiment Kraj (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Momir Vig explains that the dragon's fluid was needed to complete Experiment Kraj.
timeline.quote: explains how the dragon's cerebral fluid was needed to complete the Experiment Kraj .

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 14". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kos transfers into Savra's corpse, overpowering Svogthir, and kills Momir Vig before he can control Kraj.
timeline.quote: but then Kos kills Vig before he can take control of Kraj completely.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 16". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The narrator begins keeping a journal at the bio man's request so the treatment's effects can be tracked.
timeline.quote: the bio guy sez i need to kep a jurnal so we can tel if the stuffs workin.

citation.text: "Life is Beautiful", section "12 Orzabin 9957 Z.C.". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The narrator rescues Warrik from a mossdog-like experimental creature by choking it and slamming its head on a wall.

citation.text: "Life is Beautiful", section "21 Dhazo 9957 Z.C.". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Warrik pledges a blood debt to the narrator, and Raiche praises his improvement.
timeline.quote: Raiche is telling me how I'm supposed to be improving physikally as well as mentally

citation.text: "Life is Beautiful", section "21 Dhazo 9957 Z.C.". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The narrator excels in a running test and has his progress praised.
timeline.quote: Said that my progres wasnt like anything he'd ever seen.

citation.text: "Life is Beautiful", section "24 Dhazo 9957 Z.C.". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The narrator, now far stronger and smarter, hears whispers of induction into the Simic Combine and considers returning to help Tin Street.
timeline.quote: I have heard whispers of inducting me into the Simic Combine once the tests are over.

citation.text: "Life is Beautiful", section "8 Prazh 9957 Z.C.". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Warrik grows sick and the narrator begins to regress, while Raiche dismisses both as side effects.
timeline.quote: that Warrik was just feeling a side effect of some treatment

citation.text: "Life is Beautiful", section "30 Prazh 9957 Z.C.". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The narrator tries to smuggle Warrik out but is blocked by slime creatures; Raiche intervenes and Warrik vanishes.
timeline.quote: I turn around and Warrick wasnt were I left him.

citation.text: "Life is Beautiful", section "1 Mokosh 9957 Z.C.". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The narrator's mind dulls and he can no longer remember where Warrik is.
timeline.quote: iv trid to find him but i kant remembr were evrything is now.

citation.text: "Life is Beautiful", section "3 Mokosh 9957 Z.C.". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The narrator's body melts into yellow slime and he fears he is dying.
timeline.quote: im skared. slim is driping on the skrol.

citation.text: "Life is Beautiful", section "8 Mokosh 9957 Z.C.". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Raiche reports to Momir Vig that ZV29K is now a mindless cytoplastic life form held with the others, and that the human trials are nearly complete.
timeline.quote: The resulting cytoplastic life form is now kept in the Eastern Holding Facility with the others

citation.text: "Life is Beautiful", section "Official Communication, 17 Mokosh 9957 Z.C.". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
